result.description: CRM platform for marketing, sales, service and CMS, with a broad public REST API for CRM objects and more.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 is required for multi-account apps. Static auth tokens and service keys (bearer tokens) are single-account only. Developer API key (hapikey) is only for a few developer-level endpoints. Legacy private-app tokens and API keys are deprecated.
result.access_detail: Developer accounts and app creation are self-serve. Private distribution is capped at 10 allowlisted accounts. A marketplace-distribution OAuth app is capped at 25 installs until HubSpot lists it, and listing needs Marketplace review. Per-user static tokens and service keys are single-account and need no review. Beyond 25 customers, an agent toolkit needs the HubSpot Marketplace review. I did not confirm the pricing page. The CRM APIs are generally available on free CRM accounts, but I have not cited that.
result.api_notes: Date-versioned REST API at api.hubapi.com (2026-03, 2026-09). It covers CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, custom objects, and many more), CMS, marketing, conversations and webhooks. Hundreds of endpoints.
result.blocker: A public multi-tenant OAuth app is limited to 25 installs until it passes HubSpot Marketplace listing review. Private distribution is limited to 10 accounts.

evidence.quote: If you plan to distribute your app to multiple accounts (either through listing on the HubSpot Marketplace or by managing specific authorized accounts), your app must be built using OAuth authentication.
can be installed in up to 25 accounts (not including developer test accounts).
For apps with a `private` distribution, you can install your app in a maximum of 10 HubSpot accounts.
All APIs, whether legacy, new, or beta, use the same root path as before: `https://api.hubapi.com/`.
The remote HubSpot MCP server is a publicly hosted endpoint for connecting external AI tools and applications to HubSpot's CRM.
